title: Mokuʻula restoration master plan
summary: On August 6 the commission took no action on a plan to restore land in a fire-recovery area, though a commissioner voiced strong support. The first step would remove two tennis courts, a basketball court and a parking lot, with topsoil placed over cleared areas and archaeological and cultural monitors present. The master plan is being developed until June 2027, and the department is working with the Salvation Army to acquire land it still owns there.
